entries.source: 120 years ago Toknor and Mirvenia united the human and halfling kingdoms and wiped out the orcish race, thus establishing the Age of Ascendancy.
entries.target: 120年前，图库纳与米雯尼雅将人类与半身人的王国联合起来，将兽人一族彻底消灭，自此开启了卓越纪。

entries.source: Drakes and wyrms are the strongest natural creatures in the world, capable of powers far beyond most other beings.
entries.target: 龙与巨龙是这个世界上最强大的自然生物，它们所拥有的力量远超大多数其他生物。

entries.source: Giant worms tear open huge passageways through the deserts in the west. It is said great riches lie buried beneath the sand, still decorating the corpses of those who went there seeking great riches.
entries.target: 西部沙漠中的巨型蠕虫撕开了一条条巨大的通道。据说沙下埋藏着大量财宝，至今仍点缀在那些前去寻宝之人的尸骸上。

entries.source: Greater training in the use of armour lets it be used more effectively, blocking more damage and reducing the chance of an enemy hitting a critical spot.
entries.target: 高级的护甲训练能让你更有效地运用护甲，吸收更多伤害，并降低敌人对你造成暴击的几率。

entries.source: The Ziguranth are an ancient order vehemently opposed to magic. Some have become so attuned to nature they can resist arcane forces with their will alone.
entries.target: 伊格兰斯是一个强烈反对魔法的古老组织。其中一些人与自然高度契合，甚至能仅凭自身意志抵抗奥术力量。

entries.source: The third elven race, the Naloren, were rendered extinct after a huge cataclysm swept the eastern side of Maj'Eyal into the sea.
entries.target: 精灵的第三个分支——纳鲁精灵，在一场大灾变将马基·埃亚尔的东部地区卷入海中之后，彻底灭绝。

entries.source: The Nargol empire was once the largest force in Maj'Eyal, but a combination of the Spellblaze and orcish attacks have dwindled it into insignificance.
entries.target: 纳格尔帝国曾经是马基·埃亚尔最强大的势力，但魔法大爆炸和兽人的进攻使其日渐衰落，变得无足轻重。

entries.source: Dwarves are naturally a inquisitive people, but do not enjoy such inquisition turned on them. Most live secretive lives in their closed-off city, the Iron Throne.
entries.target: 矮人天性好奇，却不喜欢别人反过来探究他们。大多数矮人在封闭的城市——钢铁王座中，过着隐秘的生活。

entries.source: The art of potion making fell into decline after the Spellhunt, and only a rare few now master the gift.
entries.target: 猎魔行动之后，药水制作技艺逐渐衰落，如今只有极少数人掌握这门技艺。

entries.source: Maj'Eyal is the biggest continent in the world of Eyal. Though records suggest other continents and islands may exist it has not been possible to cross the wide and stormy oceans since the Spellblaze and the Cataclysm.
entries.target: 马基·埃亚尔是埃亚尔世界中最大的一块大陆。虽然记载表明可能还存在其他大陆和岛屿，但自魔法大爆炸和大灾变以来，人们一直无法横渡浩瀚而风暴肆虐的海洋。

entries.source: The highest sorcerers are known as archmages, and the masters amongst them are said to have the power to change the world. They are feared immensely.
entries.target: 元素法师被认为是最高级别的法师，据说其中的大师拥有改变世界的力量。他们令世人极为畏惧。

entries.source: Most weapons are wielded in the main hand.
entries.target: 大部分武器使用主手抓握。

entries.source: You can use shields or a second weapon in your off-hand, if you have the talents for it.
entries.target: 如果你有对应的技能，你可以副手使用盾牌或第二把武器。

entries.source: Object held in your telekinetic grasp. It can be a weapon or some other item to provide a benefit to your psionic powers.
entries.target: 使用你的念动力抓取的物品。可以是武器，也可以是其他能增强你心灵力量的物品。

entries.source: Amulets are worn around the neck.
A light source allows you to see in the dark places of the world.
entries.target: 光源可以让你看清这个世界的黑暗角落。

entries.source: Armor protects you from physical attacks. The heavier the armor the more it hinders the use of talents and spells.
entries.target: 护甲保护你免受物理攻击。护甲越重，穿着它释放技能和法术就越难。

entries.source: A cloak can simply keep you warm or grant you wondrous powers should you find a magical one.
entries.target: 斗篷可以让你保持温暖，而一些魔法斗篷可以给你神奇的力量。

entries.source: You can wear helmets or crowns on your head.
entries.target: 你可以在头上戴头盔或王冠。

entries.source: Belts are worn around your waist.
Various gloves can be worn on your hands.
entries.target: 你的手上可以戴上手套。

entries.source: Sandals or boots can be worn on your feet.
entries.target: 你的脚上可以穿上鞋子。

entries.source: This is your readied tool, always available immediately.
entries.target: 这是你准备好的工具，可以随时使用。

entries.source: Gems worn in/on the body, providing their worn bonuses.
entries.target: 装在身体内/外的宝石，提供宝石的装备属性。

entries.source: Second weapon set: In main hand
Weapon Set 2: Most weapons are wielded in the main hand. Press 'x' to switch weapon sets.
entries.target: 第二套武器：大部分武器都握在主手。按 X 键切换武器套。

entries.source: Second weapon set: In off hand
Weapon Set 2: You can use shields or a second weapon in your off-hand, if you have the talents for it. Press 'x' to switch weapon sets.
entries.target: 第二套武器：如果你有对应的技能，你可以副手使用盾牌或第二把武器。按 X 键切换武器套。
第二套武器：灵能聚焦物

entries.source: Weapon Set 2: Object held in your telekinetic grasp. It can be a weapon or some other item to provide a benefit to your psionic powers. Press 'x' to switch weapon sets.
entries.target: 第二套武器：使用你的念动力抓取的物品。你可以抓取武器，或者抓取其他物品来为你的心灵力量提供增益。按 X 键切换武器套。
第二套武器：你准备好的弹药。

entries.source: List of items that can be instantly used by swift hands.
entries.target: 无影手可即时使用的物品列表。

entries.source: Strength defines your character's ability to apply physical force. It increases your melee damage, damage done with heavy weapons, your chance to resist physical effects, and carrying capacity.
entries.target: 力量属性影响你的角色的物理能力，提升力量可以提高物理强度，提高使用重型武器造成的伤害，提高物理豁免，同时提高你的负重量。

entries.source: Dexterity defines your character's ability to be agile and alert. It increases your chance to hit, your ability to avoid attacks, and your damage with light or ranged weapons.
entries.target: 敏捷属性影响你的灵巧和警觉能力，提升敏捷可以提升命中，提升闪避，提升使用轻武器和远程武器造成的伤害。

entries.source: Magic defines your character's ability to manipulate the magical energy of the world. It increases your spell power, and the effect of spells and other magic items.
entries.target: 魔力属性影响你驾驭魔法能量的能力，提升魔力可以提高你的法术强度，以及法术和其他魔法物品的效果。

entries.source: Willpower defines your character's ability to concentrate. It increases your mana, stamina and PSI capacity, and your chance to resist mental attacks.
entries.target: 意志属性决定你的角色集中精神的能力。它会提高你的法力值、体力值与灵能值上限，并提高精神豁免。

entries.source: Cunning defines your character's ability to learn, think, and react. It allows you to learn many worldly abilities, and increases your mental capabilities and chance of critical hits.
entries.target: 灵巧属性决定你学习、思考和反应的能力。提升灵巧可以让你学习更多的技能，提升精神能力和暴击几率。

entries.source: Constitution defines your character's ability to withstand and resist damage. It increases your maximum life and physical resistance.
entries.target: 体质属性影响你抵抗和承受伤害的能力，提升体质可以提高你的最大生命值和物理豁免。

entries.source: Luck defines your character's fortune when dealing with unknown events. It increases your critical strike chance, your chance of random encounters, ...
entries.target: 幸运属性决定你的角色在面对未知事件时的运气。它可以提高你的暴击率，以及引发某些随机事件的几率。
